Answer: C
Reason: Comparing the 2003 (Figure 1) and 2007 (Figure 2) chest X-rays, there is a noticeable progression of fibrotic changes and increased pleural thickening, particularly in the upper lobes. In patients with advanced fibrotic sarcoidosis, this structural distortion creates cavities that are prone to colonization by Aspergillus species, leading to the development of an aspergillus mycetoma (fungus ball).
